title: Manibat king kalalaman ning talaga
intro: Ing pamaglakbe ning metung a kayanakan a kaladwa megumpisa ya keng metung a masikan a vision da reng celestial a bage a makayuku bilang kagalangan. Ing bie na niting indibidwal memarka ya keng pekamalalam a pamagtaksil ibat kareng pekamalapit, tinuki ya keng banuang panga-alipan ampo ing e ustung pangasukul. Dapot kapamilatan ning alang patugut a kasalpantayanan at banal a patnube, ing pigura ayni tinalakad ya ibat king pekamalating kulkul ban maging metung ya kareng pekamasikan a tau king metung a maragul a imperyu. Malyari meng abalu ing pangatau na niting makabaldugan a talasuyu nang Allah?
clues: pepakit da kanaku ing metung a vision a labing metung a batuin, ing aldo, at ing bulan a makayarap kanaku
Aku ing malalam a pakamalan a anak da reng pengari ku, a meging sangkan ning selos da reng kapatad ku
Dekap da ku ring mismung kapatad ku, likas da ku king imalan ku, at inugse da ku king malalam at madalumdum a talaga
Pisali da kung kalakal king palengki at dela da kung marayu king balen kung tibuan
Sinubukan nang ikompromiso ning metung a babaing mayupaya ing dangalan ku, at miyugse ku king sukulan uli ning e ku tinggap ing pamanyaup na
Bendisyunan na ku ning regalu ning pamagpalino king paninap, at tinalakad ku ibat king metung a makalingwan a preso angga king pun a ministru ning Ehipto

arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَكُمْ يُوسُفُ مِن قَبْلُ بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَمَا زِلْتُمْ فِى شَكٍّۢ مِّمَّا جَآءَكُم بِهِۦ ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا هَلَكَ قُلْتُمْ لَن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ رَسُولًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفٌۭ مُّرْتَابٌ
verse: And Joseph had already come to you before with clear proofs, but you remained in doubt of that which he brought to you, until when he died, you said, 'Never will Allāh send a messenger after him.' Thus does Allāh leave astray he who is a transgressor and skeptic." (40:34)
